title: Winning computation prefix
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $w$ be a finite binary string. The string $w$ is a winning computation prefix within window radius $s$ if, for every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le |w|$, the configuration reached from the initial configuration on input $x$ after reading the first $j$ choice bits of $w$ lies in the window of radius $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
